ideas.pitch: A 2D pixel-art exploration game celebrating Ahmedabad's UNESCO World Heritage status, built by high schoolers for high schoolers.
ideas.title: Heritage Heritage: Ahmedabad Tapestry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the local culture of Ahmedabad, appealing to judges through regional pride and polished 2D pixel aesthetics reminiscent of winning game jams like daydream-parkour.

ideas.pitch: An arcade-style physics web game celebrating Uttarayan where players manage wind currents and string tension to battle kites.
ideas.title: Kite Runner Jam
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages familiar regional cultural elements with high-speed interactive gameplay, ensuring a live working demo that captures judges' attention quickly.

ideas.pitch: A voice-navigated puzzle game helping players traverse architectural landmarks modeled after local heritage sites using speech recognition.
ideas.title: Voice-Controlled Sabarmati Maze
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses unique accessibility mechanics inspired by Voice-based-Pacman, demonstrating creative use of browser audio APIs within a tight 24-hour game jam window.

ideas.pitch: An interactive visual novel educating teens on water conservation and ancient stepwell architecture in Gujarat.
ideas.title: Stepwell Steward
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning formula of AquaQuest by combining compelling storytelling with educational impact on regional infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A gamified coding adventure where player actions directly trigger simulated GitHub commits to unlock game levels.
ideas.title: Git Quest: Ahmedabad Edition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to Hack Club's developer culture by blending software engineering workflows with arcade game mechanics, similar to space-commit.
